incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-83412 fired — "db-connections" high error rate detected on primary-db cluster
pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-83412: db-conn-exhaustion — page sent to @sarah, @raj
sarah: acked PD-83412 :hand: seeing 5xx spike from API, looks like DB connection failures in logs
raj: on it — hopping into pgbouncer metrics now, give me a sec
raj: pgbouncer pool usage is at 98%, max_client_conn hit frequently, accept count dropping
raj: also seeing many idle_in_transaction sessions, some long-running queries from `feature-ingest` service
jess: @sarah any customer-facing impact reported yet?
sarah: yes a small fraction of requests returning 502/503, SLO error budget is getting hit for /generate endpoint, roughly 4% errors last 5m
mike: observed Redis read latencies climbing too, might be correlated — could be blocking app threads waiting on cache miss fallbacks
raj: dumping short logs/snippet: ```
2026-03-15T08:12:01Z app[worker-4]: ERROR: could not connect to server: Too many connections
2026-03-15T08:12:01Z app[worker-1]: WARN: pgbouncer: pool full, waiting for client
2026-03-15T08:12:02Z pgbouncer[pooler]: notice: server reset, connection dropped
```
sam: estimated affected users ~0.3% of requests are 5xx but concentrated on heavy prompt sizes (long seq) — likely holding connections longer
raj: immediate mitigation plan: 1) throttle incoming long-sequence requests at edge 2) bump pgbouncer max_client_conn temporarily 3) scale read replicas / async workers to shift load 4) kill runaway idle transactions
sarah: doing step 1 now — enabling edge rate-limiter rule for payloads over 12k tokens (2msec change) :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sarah: curl -XPOST https://console.internal/edge/rate-limits -d '{"rule":"payload_tokens>12000","action":"rate_limit","limit_per_min":50}'

raj: applying pgbouncer change on one pool host to test: ```sudo sed -i 's/max_client_conn = 1000/max_client_conn = 1400/' /etc/pgbouncer/pgbouncer.ini && systemctl restart pgbouncer```
raj: rolled on host pgb-02, watching metrics

jess: note: validate max connections against postgres max_connections - we don't want to starve postgres (current postgres max_connections=2000)
raj: checked, replication connections + bg workers leave ~1600 headroom, 1400 is safe for short term
mike: starting to see accepted connections tick up and error rate drop a bit — 5xx -> 2.1% in last 2m
sam: Redis team, any signal on eviction storm or accept queue?
mike: redis accepts spiked on shard-03 — backlog increased, adding one read replica to redis cluster now: `redis-cli --cluster add-node ...` (doing in maintenance window but okay for emergency)

pagerduty-bot: PD-83412 acknowledged by sarah at 2026-03-15T08:13:50Z

sarah: calling out to on-call DB owner @jess for verification and possible promotion of replicas to readers
jess: ETA to promote standby if needed ~8-10m, will wait for raj's observation after pgbouncer bump and edge throttle
raj: killing a couple long-running txs: ```psql -c "SELECT pid, state, query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state='idle in transaction' ORDER BY state_change DESC LIMIT 10;"
SELECT * FROM pg_terminate_backend(12345);```
raj: terminated 6 sessions, backlog cleared a little
sarah: customer impact update: error rate down to 0.9% globally; high-memory customers on EU region still see sporadic 5xx, routing to secondary region for new requests enabled for EU-traffic by routing rule

mike: adding temporary circuit breaker on /generate for accounts with >3 concurrent long requests, config pushed to api-gateway
sam: internal note: saved traces show heavy KV cache misses causing DB fallthrough for prompt-embed lookups — Optimize dispatch to prefer cached embeddings where TTL valid

jess: looks stable enough to avoid promoting any replica; recommend keeping pgbouncer at 1400 for 30m and monitor. Plan for post-mortem: identify root cause (ingest job with unbounded transactions?) and add connection-leak detectors
sarah: agreed. I'll hand off to night oncall @mike in 25m with playbook steps: what we changed and rollback instructions

sarah: handoff summary: PD-83412 — db connection saturation from long-running transactions + token-burst traffic. Actions taken: edge token rate-limit enabled; pgbouncer max_client_conn increased on pool hosts (rolled to all hosts); killed runaway idle txs; scaled redis by +1 read replica; added api-gateway circuit breaker for long concurrent requests. Current: error rate ~0.6%, latency returning to baseline. Keep watch 30m.
mike: ack handoff, will monitor dashboards + paging thresholds, will escalate to DB lead if >1% errors persist for 10m

pagerduty-bot: PD-83412 escalated to on-call lead jess at 2026-03-15T08:15:35Z

sarah: filing a short incident note and linking prompt sets that triggered the burst, will open a follow-up ticket to implement connection-leak alerts and add per-tenant concurrency limits (postmortem needed) :spiral_note_pad:

sarah: thanks all — closing channel for now unless alerts re-fire :thumbsup:
